causal_passes.M16: The successful mutable-array occurrence signal directly distinguishes duplicate/reorder, and the separate arguments spread repr distinguishes drop/reorder.
causal_passes.M28: Auto Square, custom Round/Butt and legacy Butt are observed after the full frame transport, including the ordinary offset reconstruction path.

causal_failures.evidence: The carrier test compares omitted defaults against explicit default align/gaps, so the explicitness bit alone keeps equality/hash distinct if align or gap values are omitted. Its only gap-axis pair also has different row_gap/column_gap presence bits. No same-presence pair differs only in align value or only in one gap value/component.

P28 supplies only already sorted unique offsets and asserts count, orientation, negative/positive coincidence and thickness. Sorting/deduplicating those inputs changes nothing, and moving both positive and negative observations from the gap midpoint to the same cell edge preserves every assertion. There is no duplicate/out-of-order fixture or independently computed midpoint coordinate.
Every P28 and N16-N19 fixture is 2x2. Validating hline against columns and vline against rows is observationally identical when both dimensions equal two; no non-square matrix exercises the swap.

The frozen 34-test corpus never calls Content::math_matrix, the compatibility wrapper targeted by M26. The line-cap control calls math_matrix_full and observes cap, while the 23 P1430 controls contain no matrix/MathMatrix/math.mat reference. Therefore changing only the legacy wrapper column gap can survive every preseal command.

assert_scoped only asks whether any character q occurs before the first J substring and any Q occurs after it. It does not tokenize operators or prove that J lies inside one balanced matching q/Q graphics-state pair, so a leaked J can be bracketed by unrelated scopes and survive.
